Observations – 
Our market analysis shows this skill seems to be a niche. While candidates with this 
expertise exist, their experience levels and salary expectations often exceed typical market 
standards for the given experience range as listed in the job description. 
Key Findings-  
1. The availability of qualified profiles for this niche skill is limited. For example, 
platforms like Naukri currently list only few active profiles in Bengaluru. A similar 
situation is observed on LinkedIn as well. 
2. Most service-based companies are actively hiring for this skill and offering above-
market compensation. For instance, a candidate with 10 years of experience earns 
approximately ₹26.5 LPA by a service-based company. 
3. Candidates with certifications (e.g., SAP IS-Utilities, ISU Billing/DM Functional) 
typically demand salaries exceeding market standards by 30% or more, depending on 
individual cases. 
4. For this particular skill set, the active candidate pool is very limited (0 to 15 days), and 
the average notice period for candidates ranges from 60 to 90 days. 
5. Senior professionals predominantly prefer hybrid arrangements.
